confidence_notes: Recent city price indexes and local menus inform the July dining estimates. Cocktail and wine estimates use their menu prices relative to draft beer. Lodging is modeled for typical July nights, with private hostel rooms the least certain. [Livingcost](https://livingcost.org/cost/japan/matsuyama), [CityCost](https://citycost.org/compare/matsuyama-vs-tokyo/), [local drinks menu](https://brasserie-mika.com/drink/).
comparable_city_reasoning: Takamatsu and Kochi serve as lodging analogues because they are also Shikoku prefectural capitals. The estimates allow for visitor demand around Dōgo Onsen.
